title: The Silk Year
author: Barış Kısır
premise: Bursa, 1453. The silk caravan season begins the week the news arrives from Constantinople: the city has fallen, and the silk road's western door is closed. Young caravan scribe Dilara, who can read the ledgers of a dozen tongues, is given a year to open a new route — or the weavers of Bursa will starve.
